title: 第25章 两女的惊讶第26章 蕴神古树的手段
content_zh:
;;
推开房门，周尘走到百草轩大院中
门外，方青辞和秦般若正在店中安静等候
方青辞依旧是一袭素雅青衣，气质温婉，见到周尘出来，温和一笑：
“周公子，时辰不早，我们这就出发吧？”
而一旁的秦般若，则还是穿着一身惹眼的红衣长裙，窈窕身姿，魅力无限。
她双臂环抱，看到周尘出来，立刻没好气地哼了一声，明显对昨天炼丹房里的意外还耿耿于怀。
秦般若狠狠瞪了周尘一眼后，便扭过头去。
周尘直接无视秦般若，对方青辞说道：
“不好意思，两位久等了，我们现在就可以出发了。”
三人不再耽搁，离开天风城，朝着城外的落霞山脉方向疾行而去。
落霞山脉位于天风城以北，山势连绵，古木参天，深处雾气氤氲，潜藏着不少危险。
方青辞在前引路，她对这一带很是熟悉，徐徐说道：
“摘星楼有记录，那蕴神古树应该就在前方不远的一处山谷之中。”
“此地环境特殊，木灵之气异常浓郁，所以能孕育出那等奇物。”
果然没过多久，经过方青辞的指引，三人绕过一片茂密的原始林后，眼前豁然开朗。
“好浓郁的生机。”
只见一座被苍翠群山环抱的幽静山谷映入眼帘，谷中灵气氤氲，自成一方小天地。
而在山谷正中央，一株庞大到难以想象的古树巍然矗立，直插云霄。
“这便是蕴神古树？”

它的树干粗壮得如同峦的根基，茂密的树冠遮天蔽日，延伸的枝叶更是几乎笼罩了半个山谷。
方青辞神色凝重地点头道：
“不错，这正是蕴神古树。周公子，你千万别小看它。此树生长已逾千年，吸纳了不知多少天地精华，其木质早已坚逾精钢，寻常刀剑难伤分毫。”
她顿了顿，语气严肃起来：
“即便是真罡境武者全力出手，也未必能在其树干上留下多深的痕迹。”
“只有般若妹妹的南明离火这类特殊的天地异火，才能克制其木性，缓缓炼化其表层，从而汲取内蕴的木魄灵韵。”
话音刚落。
“嗷呜！”
一声咆哮骤然从侧方的密林中炸响！
紧接着，一道庞大的黑影猛地窜出，拦在了三人与古树之间！
是一头通体覆盖着暗青色坚硬皮毛的巨狼！
它獠牙外露，涎水滴落，一双幽绿色的狼眼中死气森然，死死地盯着三人。
周尘眉头一皱：“是二品妖兽，铁背苍狼！”
二品妖兽，实力相当于人族武者中的凝元境。
但妖兽天生肉身强横，力量、速度、防御都远超同阶人类修士，极其难缠。
若是成年的二品巅峰妖兽，其战力甚至能逼近真罡境武者。
秦般若看了一眼周尘，想起昨日炼丹时被这家伙占了天大的便宜，心中顿时升起一丝得意。
她双臂环抱，将红衣包裹下的双峰衬托得更加傲人下巴微扬，幸灾乐祸的轻哼道：
“哼！小子，现在知道害怕了吧？谁让你非要死皮赖脸地跟我们来这种危险的地方？”
“老老实实待在你那安全的炼丹室里摆弄你的丹药不好吗？真以为会炼几颗丹药就了不起了？外面世界的残酷，可不是你这种娇贵的炼丹师能想象的！”

Pushing open the door, Zhou Chen walked to the Baicaoxuan courtyard.
Outside the door, Fang Qingci and Qin Banruo were waiting quietly in the store
Fang Qingci was still dressed in elegant green clothes and had a gentle temperament. When he saw Zhou Chen coming out, he smiled gently:
"Mr. Zhou, it's getting late, shall we set off now?"
Qin Banruo, on the other hand, was still wearing an eye-catching red dress, with a slim figure and infinite charm.
She crossed her arms and immediately snorted angrily when she saw Zhou Chen coming out. She was obviously still worried about the accident in the alchemy room yesterday.
Qin Banruo glared at Zhou Chen fiercely, then turned away.
Zhou Chen ignored Qin Banruo and said to Fang Qingci:
"Sorry, you two have been waiting for a long time. We can leave now."
Without further delay, the three of them left Tianfeng City and headed towards the Luoxia Mountains outside the city.
Luoxia Mountain Range is located to the north of Tianfeng City. It has continuous mountains, towering ancient trees, and mist in its depths, which lurks many dangers.
Fang Qingci led the way. She was very familiar with this area and said slowly:
"There are records in Zhaixing Tower. The Yunshen Ancient Tree should be in a valley not far ahead."
"The environment here is special and the wood spirit energy is extremely strong, so it can breed such strange things."
Sure enough, not long after, after Fang Qingci's guidance, the three of them walked around a dense virgin forest, and their eyes suddenly opened up.
"What a rich vitality."
A quiet valley surrounded by green mountains came into view. The valley was full of aura and formed a small world of its own.
And in the middle of the valley, an unimaginably huge ancient tree stood majestically, reaching into the sky.
"Is this the Yunshen Ancient Tree?"
Its trunk is as thick as the foundation of the mountains, its dense crown blocks out the sky and the sun, and its extending branches and leaves cover almost half of the valley.
Fang Qingci nodded solemnly and said:
"Yes, this is the Yunshen Ancient Tree. Mr. Zhou, please don't underestimate it. This tree has grown for more than a thousand years and has absorbed countless essences of heaven and earth. Its wood has long been stronger than fine steel, and it is difficult for ordinary swords to damage it."
She paused and her tone became serious:
"Even if a Zhen Gang Realm warrior attacks with all his strength, he may not be able to leave deep marks on the tree trunk."
"Only special heaven and earth fires such as Sister Prajna's Nanming Lihuo can restrain its wood nature, slowly refine its surface, and absorb the inner spirit of wood soul."
The words just fell.
"Ouch!"
A roar suddenly exploded from the dense forest on the side!
Immediately afterwards, a huge black shadow suddenly jumped out and blocked the three people and the ancient tree!
It's a giant wolf covered with dark blue hard fur!
Its fangs were exposed, saliva was dripping, and a pair of green wolf eyes stared at the three of them with a deathly look.
Zhou Chen frowned: "It's a second-grade monster, an iron-backed wolf!"
The strength of a second-grade monster is equivalent to that of the Condensing Yuan realm among human warriors.
However, monster beasts are naturally physically powerful, and their strength, speed, and defense far exceed that of human monks of the same level, making them extremely difficult to deal with.
If it is an adult second-grade peak monster, its combat power can even approach that of a Zhen Gang Realm warrior.
Qin Banruo glanced at Zhou Chen and remembered that this guy had taken advantage of him yesterday when he was refining the elixir, and he suddenly felt a sense of pride in his heart.
She crossed her arms, making her breasts wrapped in red clothes even more proud, her chin slightly raised, and she hummed in gloating:
"Hmph! Boy, do you know how to be afraid now? Who told you to come to such a dangerous place with us shamelessly?"
"Wouldn't it be better to just stay in your safe alchemy room and play with your elixirs? Do you really think it's a big deal that you can refine a few elixirs? The cruelty of the outside world is beyond the imagination of a delicate alchemist like you!"
